subject: PE: Pineworks supplier invite — SSO/tenant affinity routing issue
messages:
From: Emily Foster <emily.foster@pineworks.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem accepting supplier portal invite - Pineworks

Hi Jonas,

We received the invite link for Redwood's Coupa supplier portal but when our AP lead clicks Accept it lands on a page that says 'Tenant not found' and then redirects to a Pineworks internal login (we have multiple Pineworks tenants). The result is the invite never binds to the supplier record and the PO is stuck in "Pending supplier action".

Screenshot attached (screenshot_invite_error.png).

We're trying to get PO #PW-1298 released today — can you help?

What we tried so far:
- Clearing cookies and retrying in Chrome (same result)
- Trying an incognito window (router still returned tenant mismatch)
- One of our users reported being routed to a different Pineworks subdomain after SSO handoff

Can you confirm whether the invite token is tied to an expected IdP relay/relaystate or domain? Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Emily Foster
Senior Procurement Manager
Pineworks Inc.
emily.foster@pineworks.com

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Hi Emily — thanks for the detail and the screenshot. That helps.

Quick questions so we can scope:
1) Which exact Pineworks account/subdomain did you click the invite from (e.g. pineworks.com vs pineworks-global.com)?
2) Which SSO provider does Pineworks use for procurement (Okta, Azure AD, etc.)?
3) Can you send the buyer-facing invite URL you received (just the domain + path is fine, redact token if needed)?

I suspect this may be a tenant-affinity / relaystate mismatch at SSO handoff — sometimes when organizations have multiple IdP sessions the relay can land in the wrong tenant, which causes our portal to reject the claim.

I’ve looped in Ben from identity/ops to help validate server-side handoffs and to pull logs. If you can confirm answers to the three questions above I’ll push a call today or provide step-by-step instructions.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Foster <emily.foster@pineworks.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite - Pineworks

Hi Emily,

Thanks for the screenshot and context. I pulled the invite token reference (PINE-472) and our logs show the initial accept request did reach our auth gateway but the SSO assertion carried an unexpected NameID/tenant claim that mapped to a different Pineworks tenant (looks like an existing session cookie bound to pineworks-global). That explains the 'Tenant not found' landing.

Immediate remediation steps that usually unblock this class of issue:
1) Use a private/incognito browser session (ensures no existing Pineworks SSO cookies).
2) If the user still hits the wrong tenant, please ask them to explicitly logout from their Pineworks IdP domain (e.g., okta.pineworks.com) and attempt the invite again.
3) Alternatively, we can reissue an invite that uses the explicit redirect parameter (I can generate one that forces the redirect target).

I attached a small audit snippet showing the accept flow (audit_log_excerpt.txt). If you'd prefer, I can reissue a fresh invite (one-time link) — say the quickest option is to try private browsing first.

If we need to reissue, let me know the exact recipient email to bind and I'll produce a one-time accept link that skips tenant-lookup heuristics.

Best,
Ben Carter
Identity & Platform Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Emily Foster <emily.foster@pineworks.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite - Pineworks

Jonas / Ben — thanks, the private window approach worked. We had been testing from an account that also authenticates to a different Pineworks tenant (ugh). After logging out of the IdP and re-clicking the invite in a private session the accept completed and the PO was released.

I attached the acceptance receipt for your records (acceptance_receipt.pdf).

Appreciate the rapid help — Pineworks finance will proceed with PO PW-1298. If we run into this again I’ll reach out and we may take the one-time link.

Best regards,
Emily Foster
Senior Procurement Manager
Pineworks Inc.
